summary: Comprehensive plan to expand BrickVerse with 6 brand new 3D games (Zombie Defense Outpost, Paintball CTF, Rollercoaster Theme Park, Prop Hunt Mystery, Kart Racing Speedway, Laser Tag Arena), 6 interactive gears (Rocket Launcher, Grappling Hook, Jetpack, Laser Katana, Super Pogo Stick, Ghost Cloak), and a full Daily Missions & Quests reward system.
